text.en:
The fifth WHEREAS clause of Executive Order No. 74
dated 15 January 1999 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"WHEREAS, under the Denso AICO Arrangement, the
Philippines (Philippines Auto Component, Inc.) will import from
Thailand (Denso International (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and Denso
(Thailand) Co., Ltd.) certain original equipment manufacture
(OEM) automotive parts/components."

Section 6 of Executive Order No. 74 dated 15 January
1999 is hereby amended to read as follows:
" The AICO rates provided in Annex "A" shall be accorded to
the AICO entities in Thailand (Denso International (Thailand) Co.,
Ltd., and Denso (Thailand) Co., Ltd.) upon the effectivity of this
Executive Order.

The third WHEREAS clause of Executive Order No. 162
dated 10 January 2003 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"WHEREAS, under the Denso AICO Arrangement, the
Philippines (Philippines Auto Component, Inc.) will import from
Thailand (Denso International (Thailand) Co., Ltd, and Denso
(Thailand) Co., Ltd.) certain original equipment manufacture
(OEM) automotive parts/components."

Section 2 of Executive Order No. 162 dated 10 January
2003 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"The AICO rates provided in Annex "A" shall be accorded
to the AICO entities in Thailand (Denso International (Thailand)
Co., Ltd., and Denso (Thailand) Co., Ltd.) upon the effectivity
of this Executive Order".

1999 is hereby amended to read as follows:
